summary: Frontend-only smoke regression test after dependency dedup (@react-navigation pinning + expo-asset lock). All critical navigation/rendering paths verified on web preview at 390x844. App loads cleanly (no black/white screen), login with apple.reviewer@nightfinder.app / Reviewer2026! succeeds, all 5 bottom tabs (Discover, Map, Swipe, Events, Profile) switch correctly with distinct content rendered per tab, paywall modal opens from /profile premium-card and back-navigation returns to /profile, and a stack screen (favorites) opens and pops cleanly. No react-navigation / expo-router console errors detected. Only console errors observed are 2 expected 401s on initial token-check (unauthenticated /auth/me before login). PASS — no regression from the dependency pinning.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding screen is shown before login on every cold web reload (no AsyncStorage on web persisting completion). Not a regression — pre-existing behavior — but worth noting for App Store reviewer who may need to tap 'Passer' before reaching login.

Console still emits the long-standing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents) and an expo-notifications web-not-supported warning. These are pre-existing, non-blocking, and unrelated to the dependency pin.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded reviewer account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dependency-pin regression smoke test only (iteration_8). Reviewer login OK, 5 tabs navigate OK, stack push/pop OK, paywall modal OK. If a future change touches @react-navigation versions or expo-router, rerun this exact smoke flow: goto root → Passer → login apple.reviewer@nightfinder.app/Reviewer2026! → click tabs [tab-discover, tab-map, tab-swipe, tab-events, tab-profile] → click premium-card (paywall) → go_back → click row-favorites → go_back. Detect navigation errors with regex /navigation|expo-router|@react-navigation/i on console.error stream.
